claim: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Claude Code, programmable in Python and TypeScript
quote: Build AI agents that autonomously read files, run commands, search the web, edit code, and more. The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Claude Code, programmable in Python and TypeScript.

claim: The core agent feedback loop is Gather Context → Take Action → Verify Work → Repeat
quote: Gather Context → Take Action → Verify Work → Repeat. This design mirrors how Claude Code operates, providing a reusable framework for building autonomous agents beyond just coding tasks.

claim: Python SDK install command is pip install claude-agent-sdk, requires Python 3.10+
quote: The Python package requires Python 3.10 or later.

claim: TypeScript SDK install command is npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk; bundles a native Claude Code binary
quote: The TypeScript SDK bundles a native Claude Code binary for your platform as an optional dependency, so you don't need to install Claude Code separately.

claim: Add -p/--print flag to run Claude Code non-interactively; --bare skips all local config discovery and is recommended for CI
quote: --bare is the recommended mode for scripted and SDK calls, and will become the default for -p in a future release.

claim: Subagents run in fresh context windows for isolation; subagents cannot spawn their own subagents
quote: Each subagent runs in its own fresh conversation. Intermediate tool calls and results stay inside the subagent; only its final message returns to the parent... Subagents cannot spawn their own subagents. Don't include Agent in a subagent's tools array.

claim: Official SDK demos include multi-agent research system, branding assistant, resume generator, and spreadsheet agent
quote: A multi-agent research system that coordinates specialized subagents to research topics and generate comprehensive reports.

claim: Dynamic workflows are in research preview; require Claude Code v2.1.154+; support up to 16 concurrent agents and 1000 total per run
quote: Up to 16 concurrent agents, fewer on machines with limited CPU cores... 1,000 agents total per run. Prevents runaway loops.

claim: Hooks are callback functions that intercept agent events like PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop; multiple PreToolUse hooks run in parallel with deny winning
quote: When multiple hooks or permission rules apply, deny takes priority over defer, which takes priority over ask, which takes priority over allow.

claim: Managed Agents is a hosted REST API in beta where Anthropic runs the agent and sandbox; best for long-running async tasks without operating infrastructure
quote: Long-running execution: Tasks that run for minutes or hours with multiple tool calls. Minimal infrastructure: No need to build your own agent loop, sandbox, or tool execution layer.

claim: Claude Code GitHub Actions v1.0 uses claude-code-action@v1 and passes CLI flags via claude_args; supports Bedrock and Vertex via OIDC
quote: Claude Code GitHub Actions brings AI-powered automation to your GitHub workflow. With a simple @claude mention in any PR or issue, Claude can analyze your code, create pull requests, implement features, and fix bugs.

claim: Sessions persist to ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>.jsonl; three modes: continue (most recent), resume (by ID), fork (new branch)
quote: A session is the conversation history the SDK accumulates while your agent works. It contains your prompt, every tool call the agent made, every tool result, and every response.

claim: Starting June 15 2026, Agent SDK usage draws from separate monthly credits: $20 Pro, $100 Max 5x, $200 Max 20x; interactive use unaffected
quote: Starting June 15, 2026, Agent SDK usage separates from standard subscription limits and becomes eligible for dedicated monthly credits.

claim: anthropics/claude-code-action is the official GitHub Action built on the Agent SDK, supporting @claude mentions and scheduled automation
quote: Claude Code GitHub Actions is built on top of the Claude Agent SDK, which enables programmatic integration of Claude Code into your applications.

claim: Claude Code is the interactive coding assistant; the Agent SDK exposes the same engine for programmatic use
quote: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Claude Code.

claim: The MCP servers registry covers databases, browsers, Slack, GitHub, Asana, and hundreds more connectors
quote: Connect to external systems via the Model Context Protocol: databases, browsers, APIs, and hundreds more.

claim: SessionStart and SessionEnd hooks are TypeScript-only as SDK callbacks; Python can only use them as settings-file shell command hooks
quote: SessionStart and SessionEnd can be registered as SDK callback hooks in TypeScript, but are not available in the Python SDK.

claim: The ultracode keyword triggers automatic workflow orchestration; /effort ultracode enables it per-session
quote: To run a single task as a workflow without changing the session's effort level, include the keyword ultracode in your prompt... Claude treats a direct request as the same opt-in.
